findings.app: <Stop offset="0.72" stopColor="#131313" stopOpacity={0} /> — react-native-svg interpolates the RGB as well, so the ramp drifts toward near-black and the whole bloom composites 6–8/255 too dark
findings.note: Measured on every captured pair over canvas y 56–130 (the strip below the status bar, excluding the rule and the Back row): design-minus-app mean +0.55…+0.62, worst +6 to +8/255, on all 22 frames; Enlisting Aegis, which draws no corner bloom, is at −0.04 / worst 2. Consistently one-directional, so it is not antialiasing. `node scripts/vicifull/stopcheck.mjs` lists this exact line, and .vicifull/FINDINGS.md F23 already records it as a CONFIRMED defect ("src/components/onboarding/v3.tsx:283 … the same line, six tail frames and the whole funnel") under DECISIONS D048's rule: when a CSS radial becomes an SVG gradient the zero-alpha stop must take the RGB of the opaque stop. The funnel report does not mention it. Its own instrument cannot see it: .vicifull/funnel-pxdiff3.mjs starts at device row 110 (css y 55) and counts a pixel only where the design's 3×3 neighbourhood varies by ≤6, so a gradient wash is structurally excluded — which is why the report reads "0 flat pixels" on every frame. Most of the bloom sits above canvas y 54, where the design frame paints its own status bar and no comparison is possible, so the 6–8/255 measured in the fringe is the floor, not the peak. Fix: stopColor="#B4AA96" on the 0.72 stop. Note the identical line at src/components/onboarding/tail.tsx:61 belongs to the tail group.

summary:
All 23 frames were driven to the exact state their frame draws, captured headlessly (sig prefix v-funnel-), diffed row-by-row with sigdiff, and diffed pixel-wise with a NEW instrument I wrote for this pass (.vicifull/vfunnel-blockdiff.mjs: 8×8 block means, which kill antialiasing but not a missing shape, a wrong gradient or a shifted box — unlike the report's funnel-pxdiff3.mjs it does not skip gradient regions). Every PNG was also read.

The implementation is genuinely strong: the nine new header drawings, the 09A compass's SVG <text> "N" in sans (D074 does not bite), the 30×30 gauge rings, the 26×26 tail marks on 22, the crescent/pillow glyphs (D076), First Principle's real FeGaussianBlur ground shadow (D075 — I checked its geometry against the canvas and it is exact), 16 · Impact's absent low sun, and all copy including the frames' curly apostrophes. src/content/onboardingFunnel.ts is in sync: I re-ran scripts/vicifull/gen-funnel.mjs and the output is byte-identical. The copy sweep reports nothing missing for any of the 23 frames.

TWO REAL DEFECTS SURVIVE.

(1) The top-left corner bloom is drawn 6–8/255 too dark on 22 of the 23 frames. src/components/onboarding/v3.tsx:283 gives the zero-alpha stop stopColor="#131313" where the opaque stop is #B4AA96, so react-native-svg interpolates the RGB toward near-black. This is FINDINGS.md F23's already-CONFIRMED defect, naming this exact line, and the report does not mention it. The reason it was missed is instructive: the report's funnel-pxdiff3.mjs counts a pixel only where the design's 3×3 neighbourhood is flat, and starts at device row 110 — so a gradient wash near the top of the frame is doubly invisible to it. That is why "0 flat pixels" is reported on frames that are measurably wrong. Fix is one token.

(2) 03 · Name's Back row is still not drawn. The report frames this as an open call under D016; FINDINGS.md F13 is titled "DECIDED … reversing D016" and specifies both halves of the fix. Neither is in the tree: welcome.tsx still passes onBack={null} at i===0 and (auth)/_layout.tsx still redirects unconditionally with no onboarding-incomplete exemption.

Three smaller items are recorded with honest confidence: First Principle's bloom band runs 2–6/255 dark (D010's accepted radial approximation, one-directional, the largest residual outside the two above); 13 · Place's bed-pillow edge differs by 62 subpixels; and the group's specs/ files still transcribe withdrawn copy.

I also drove and confirmed every piece of questionnaire logic no frame can state: 09B skipped on "No" at 09A (lands on 10 · First principle); the exclusive answers on 12, 14 and 22 each clear the rest (verified in the signature — only the exclusive row carries rgba(255,255,255,0.13)/0.45); 17 refuses a fourth pick; 23's "Set a limit" reading renders at the frame's own 338/434 with the clarifier correctly absent; the under-18 gate fires at 04. windowFor() covers all nine of 11 · When's renamed labels and O3_ISSUE all nine of 12 · Beforehand's. I re-grepped all 22 dead exports in v3.tsx: genuinely unreferenced (the 8 hits for "O3Letter" are handover.tsx's O3LetterArrived/O3LetterRead, a different symbol).

The two glyph oddities that look like bugs are not: 17 · What it affects really does give "Time" a crescent and "Sleep" a clock, and 12 · Beforehand really does give "Lonely" a clock — the canvas draws them that way and the app matches at 0 blocks over 8/255.
